lureOrb.reason: Clean soft alpha, no rectangle or fringe; warm bioluminescent orb on a thread reads as an anglerfish lure and is far more legible and painterly than the shipped blue puff. Thread is slightly thin/dark at 80px but acceptable.

tuskGore.reason: Crisp ivory crescent with stained, textured surface, clean edge alpha, reads instantly as a tusk gore arc; shipped version is a muddy dust smear that reads as debris.
